name: Seven-Phase Flash
description:
When the character to which this is attached uses a Normal Attack: Converts Physical DMG dealt to Cryo DMG. If possible, consume up to 2 Serpent's Subtlety, and for each point consumed, reduce the cost by 1 Unaligned Element.
The character's Elemental Burst changes to Havoc: Extinction.
Duration (Rounds): 1
